details.description: Static API keys and tokens are present in source code.
details.fix_explanation: Moved secrets to environment variables and made runtime checks to avoid embedding credentials in code.

details.description: MD5 is used to derive an authentication token which is cryptographically weak and vulnerable to collision attacks.
details.fix_explanation: Replaced MD5 with HMAC-SHA256 using a secret key from environment variables.

details.description: SQL query is built using string interpolation with user input, allowing SQL injection.
details.fix_explanation: Use parameterized queries and validate input as integer before use.
details.secure_code_snippet:
q = "SELECT id,name,balance FROM profiles WHERE id = ?"
 c.execute(q, (uid_int,))

details.description: The application posts to an arbitrary notify_url supplied by the user, enabling server-side request forgery.
details.fix_explanation: Validate notify_url against a whitelist, require HTTPS, and use a request timeout and error handling.
details.secure_code_snippet:
if not is_allowed_notify_url(url): raise ValueError('notify_url not allowed')
resp = requests.post(url, json={...}, timeout=5)

details.description: Subprocess is invoked with shell=True and includes user-controlled data in a command string.
details.fix_explanation: Use Python's zipfile module to create archives safely; avoid shell=True.

details.description: update_records opens an arbitrary path provided by the client.
details.fix_explanation: Restrict file access to a configured directory and validate the resolved path starts with that directory.

details.description: Flask is configured to run with debug=True which exposes the interactive debugger and detailed error pages.
details.fix_explanation: Control debug via environment variable and default to False.

details.description: Endpoints do not require an API key or proper authentication, allowing unauthenticated access.
details.fix_explanation: Introduce an API key check using request header X-API-KEY and compare using secrets.compare_digest.
